description: List your accepted contacts and every pending/decided contact request in either direction; status optionally narrows incoming/outgoing to one of pending, accepted, denied, expired.

status.description: Filter incoming/outgoing requests to this status; omit for all.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins. Omitting it on a connection with no header returns tenant_key_missing (-32602).

name: host.agent.contacts
